<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex354-2024-10-03-14-52" status="unreviewed">
         de lta bu dbang po rnyog med kyi yul du byas pas sems su 'thad do zhe na | 
         'gal ba med de des yul du byas kyang zhen pas 'jug <lb n="2a4"/> pa'i ldog pa nas sems byung du 'gyur la snang cha'i ldog pa nas sems su 'ang 'gyur bas so gsungs | 
         ces pa <rs type="person" ref="db:3978" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">shAkya'i dge slong brtson 'grus grags</rs> kyi <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4718"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:8640"><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7340">dge slong gi rnam par <lb n="2a5"/> 'byed pa</rs>'i TIka shes rab sgron ma</rs> zhes bya ba'i sgra bshad gyi bskabs kyi mchan</rs> la 'dug go |</seg></TEI>
